items.text: Israeri akanga ari mutsvene kuna Jehovha,
Inzwai shoko raJehovha imi imba yaJakobho,
iye akatibudisa kubva munyika yeIjipiti akatitungamirira nomugwenga risina miti,
kuti mudye zvibereko zvayo nezvakanaka zvayo.
mukaita nhaka yangu kuti ive chinhu chinonyangadza.
muone kana pakambova nechimwe chinhu chakadai:
Ko, rudzi rwakambotsinhanisa vamwari varwo here?
Asi vanhu vangu vakatsinhanisa kukudzwa kwavo
Haiwa, imi matenga, shamiswai nechinhu ichi,
Ko, Israeri muranda here, kana nhapwa pakuberekwa?
maguta ake akapiswa uye haachina vanhu.
Ko, hauna kuzvivigira izvozvo pachako here
Rangarira uye uyeuke zvino kuti zvakaipa sei
ndizvo zvinotaura Ishe, Jehovha Wamasimba Ose.
Zvirokwazvo, pamusoro pechikomo chirefu choga choga,
uye pasi pomuti woga woga wakapfumvutira,
gwapa remhosva yako rinoramba riri mberi kwangu,"
Mukono upi noupi unoitevera haufaniri kuzvinetesa;
dzisisina shangu nehuro yako yava nenyota.
ivo namadzimambo avo uye namachinda avo,
nyamba pavanenge vava munhamo, vanoti kwandiri,
"Haiwa, imi vechizvarwa ichi, rangarirai Shoko raJehovha rinoti:
Ko, murandakadzi angakanganwa zvishongo zvake here,
nomwenga angakanganwa nguo dzake dzomuchato here?
Kunyange vakadzi vakaipisisa vangadzidza kubva panzira dzenyu.
nokuti Jehovha akaramba vose vaunovimba navo;
